noncomputable def bound_4_51 (x : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (U V : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let D := U * V
  let c₁ := 1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)
  2 * √(c₀ * c₁) / π *
      (D * Real.log (D / √(rexp 1)) +
        q * (√3 * Real.log (3 * D) + (2 + Real.log D / 2) * logPlus (D / (q / 2)))) +
    3 * c₁ / 2 * (x / q) * Real.log D * logPlus (D / (c₂ * x / q)) +
    2 * eta2'L1 / π * q * max 1 (Real.log (c₀ * rexp 3 * q ^ 2 / (4 * π * eta2'L1 * x))) *
      logPlus (q / 2) +
    3 * c₁ / 2 * √(2 * x / c₂) * (Real.log (3 * √(c₂ * x / 2)) + 1) +
    (2 * √c₀ / π * √(2 * c₂ * x) * (2 + 12 * Real.log (5 * D)) + 5 * c₀ / (6 * π ^ 2))

note: The last term of (6.66) should have (2c₂)^{3/2} for (3c₂)^{1/2}; the total 1177.76 still holds. Lean bounds its own form of (4.51) at Q₀ = x^{2/3}/349 and c₀ = 32, keeping the lower-order terms as a polynomial in log x.
